title: Keith house's entrance loggia lowered to the 1888 photograph's height
items: 1808 Prairie (1904): the entrance loggia's pedestals now stand 0.88 m and its paired columns 2.2 m, down from 1.0 m and 2.5 m, with the pierced parapet between the pedestals lowered to match. The balcony above drops about 40 cm with them.

The 1888 Inland Architect photograph can now be matched with a camera where a photographer could actually have stood: about 21 m out, across Prairie Avenue, 2.2 m up. With the loggia at its old height, every fitted camera ended up at ground level inside the houses across the street.
